semiconductor_relevance: High — Umicore Thin Film Products specializes in sputtering targets and evaporation materials essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Umicore Thin Film Products is a leading developer and manufacturer of high-quality sputtering targets and evaporation materials used in microelectronics. Their extensive product portfolio, supported by advanced R&D and recycling capabilities, positions them as a one-stop solution for semiconductor applications.

regional_presence.Liechtenstein: Umicore Thin Film Products has a manufacturing facility in Balzers, Liechtenstein, certified under ISO standards for quality and environmental management.
